blurb: Lakers titles from the BAA days to the Shaq-Kobe three-peat and Pau

questions.q: In 2010, the Lakers won Game 7 of the NBA Finals against which longtime rival?
questions.fact: It was the 12th time the two franchises had met in the NBA Finals.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Celtics-Lakers_rivalry (table of 12 Finals meetings, 1959-2010; 2010 Game 7 won by LA)

questions.q: Larry Bird coached which team that lost to the Lakers in the 2000 NBA Finals?
questions.fact: It was Indiana's first trip to the NBA Finals, and LA won the series in six games.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2000_NBA_Finals (Larry Bird coached Indiana; Pacers' first NBA Finals; LA won 4-2)

questions.q: The 1972 Lakers, a 69-win team, beat which team in the NBA Finals?
questions.fact: Wilt Chamberlain was named Finals MVP as LA won the series 4-1.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1972_NBA_Finals (LA beat Knicks 4-1; Chamberlain Finals MVP; 69 regular-season wins, so 69-13)

questions.q: The Lakers won the 1949 BAA Finals against which team, coached by a young Red Auerbach?
questions.fact: It took six games, and a year earlier the Lakers had won the title of the rival NBL.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1949_BAA_Finals (beat Capitols 4-2; Auerbach coached Washington); en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Kundla (1948 NBL championship)

questions.q: Who was Finals MVP for all three Lakers titles from 2000 to 2002?
questions.fact: He was the second player, after Michael Jordan, to win Finals MVP three years in a row.
questions.src: nba.com/history/top-moments/2002-lakers-complete-three-peat (O'Neal Finals MVP all three runs; only player besides Jordan to do it)

questions.q: In 1980, which Lakers rookie won Finals MVP after starting Game 6 at center?
questions.fact: He had 42 points, 15 rebounds and 7 assists as LA clinched the title in Philadelphia.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1980_NBA_Finals (Game 6 in Philadelphia: rookie Magic started at center, 42 pts, 15 reb, 7 ast; Finals MVP)

questions.q: Kobe Bryant won his first Finals MVP in 2009 against which team?
questions.fact: LA won the series 4-1 for the franchise's 15th championship.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2009_NBA_Finals (beat Orlando 4-1; Bryant Finals MVP; 15th franchise title); Shaq won 2000-02 Finals MVPs

questions.q: Who was the 1988 Finals MVP after a 36-point triple-double in Game 7?
questions.fact: It was the first triple-double of his career, and LA beat Detroit 108-105 at the Forum.
questions.src: nba.com/history/legends/profiles/james-worthy (Game 7: 36 pts, 16 reb, 10 ast; first career triple-double; 108-105 at the Forum; Finals MVP)

questions.q: Before moving to Los Angeles in 1960, the Lakers played in which city?
questions.fact: Coach John Kundla led Minneapolis to five NBA-recognized titles from 1949 to 1954.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Kundla (1949 BAA + 1950/52/53/54 NBA titles = five BAA/NBA; Bob Short moved team to LA in 1960)

questions.q: Besides Kobe Bryant, which player was on all five Lakers title teams from 2000 to 2010?
questions.fact: In 2004, he beat San Antonio with a shot launched with 0.4 seconds left.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Derek_Fisher (titles 2000, 01, 02, 09, 10; 0.4 shot May 13, 2004, Game 5 vs Spurs). Brian Shaw dropped: Lakers assistant for 2009-10 titles (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brian_Shaw_(basketball))

questions.q: The 2001 Lakers lost only one playoff game. What was their playoff record?
questions.fact: The lone loss came in overtime, in Game 1 of the Finals against Philadelphia.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2001_NBA_playoffs (Lakers 15-1; best-of-five first round; only loss Game 1 of Finals, 107-101 OT vs 76ers)

questions.q: How many games long was the Lakers' famous winning streak during the 1971-72 season?
questions.fact: Milwaukee ended the streak, 120-104, on January 9, 1972.
questions.src: nba.com/news/legendary-moments-bucks-end-lakers-33-game-win-streak (Nov 5, 1971 to Jan 9, 1972; Bucks won 120-104)

blurb: Retired numbers, superstars and coaches from Baylor and West to Kobe and Pau

questions.q: Which two jersey numbers did the Lakers retire for Kobe Bryant?
questions.fact: In 2017 he became the first NBA player to have two numbers retired by the same team.
questions.src: nba.com/article/2017/12/18/nba-players-two-numbers-retired ('the first in NBA history to have two numbers retired by the same team')

questions.q: Which jersey number did the Lakers retire for Magic Johnson?
questions.fact: He won five titles, three MVPs and three Finals MVPs, all with the Lakers.
questions.src: nba.com/news/la-lakers-retired-numbers (Magic No. 32: five titles, three MVPs, three Finals MVPs; 33 Kareem, 34 Shaq)

questions.q: In 2023, the Lakers retired No. 16 for which star of their 2009 and 2010 title teams?
questions.fact: LA got him from Memphis in 2008 in a trade that sent his brother Marc's draft rights there.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pau_Gasol (traded from Memphis Feb 1, 2008, Marc's draft rights to Memphis; No. 16 retired March 7, 2023)

questions.q: Which number did the Lakers retire in 2012 for Showtime forward Jamaal 'Silk' Wilkes?
questions.fact: Before LA, he won the 1975 title and Rookie of the Year with Golden State.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jamaal_Wilkes (No. 52 retired Dec 28, 2012; 1975 ROY and title with Golden State); nba.com retired numbers (42 Worthy, 25 Goodrich, 44 West)

questions.q: What was the name of Kareem Abdul-Jabbar's signature shot?
questions.fact: Kareem won six MVP awards: three with Milwaukee and three with the Lakers.
questions.src: nba.com/news/history-nba-legend-kareem-abdul-jabbar (trademark sky-hook; six-time MVP, three with Bucks); nba.com/news/la-lakers-retired-numbers (three more MVPs with LA)

questions.q: Shaquille O'Neal signed with the Lakers in 1996, leaving which team?
questions.fact: He had led Orlando to the 1995 Finals, where Houston swept the Magic.
questions.src: cbssports.com inside story of Shaq leaving the Magic (July 1996 to the Lakers); en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1995_NBA_Finals (Rockets swept Magic 4-0)

questions.q: In a 1962 Finals game at Boston Garden, Elgin Baylor set a Finals record by scoring how many points?
questions.fact: He also grabbed 22 rebounds as LA won that Game 5, 126-121.
questions.src: basketball-reference.com box score 196204140BOS (Game 5, 61 pts, 22 reb, LA 126-121); nba.com/news/history-top-moments-elgin-baylor-scores-61-in-finals; sports.yahoo.com 'Elgin Baylor sets NBA Finals scoring record'

questions.q: The Lakers acquired 1996 draft pick Kobe Bryant in a trade with which team?
questions.fact: Charlotte took him 13th overall, and LA sent center Vlade Divac to get him.
questions.src: cbssports.com/nba/news/kobe-bryant-and-the-draft-day-trade-that-changed-nba-history (Charlotte took him 13th; LA sent Vlade Divac; finalized July 11)

questions.q: Which Lakers coach was nicknamed the 'Zen Master'?
questions.fact: He won 11 titles as a coach: six with Chicago and five with the Lakers.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phil_Jackson ('Zen Master'; 11 titles: Bulls 1991-93, 96-98; Lakers 2000-02, 09, 10)

questions.q: On the 1972 champion Lakers, what was Pat Riley's role?
questions.fact: He later called Lakers games on the air before joining the bench as an assistant in 1979.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pat_Riley (reserve on 1972 champions; Lakers broadcaster from 1977; assistant under Westhead from November 1979)

questions.q: Shaquille O'Neal won his only regular-season MVP award in which season?
questions.fact: He got 120 of 121 first-place votes; the other one went to Allen Iverson.
questions.src: archive.seattletimes.com 2000-05-10 'Shaq comes one vote from unanimous MVP' (120 of 121 first-place votes; other to Iverson; first MVP)

questions.q: Jerry West won the first Finals MVP award in 1969, even though LA lost the series to which team?
questions.fact: West averaged 37.9 points per game in that seven-game series.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1969_NBA_Finals (first Finals MVP, only one from a losing team; Celtics won 4-3); espn.com/classic/biography/s/West_Jerry.html ('averaged 37.9 points against Boston')

blurb: The Forum, Chick Hearn, famous moments and the nicknames of Lakers lore

questions.q: Staples Center, the Lakers' arena that opened in 1999, was later renamed for which company?
questions.fact: It opened in downtown Los Angeles with 18,997 seats for Lakers games.
questions.src: abc7.com and fox news reports (Staples Center became Crypto.com Arena Dec 25, 2021); en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crypto.com_Arena (opened Oct 17, 1999); nba.com/lakers/history/season-capsule ('18,997-seat STAPLES Center in Downtown Los Angeles')

questions.q: The Forum, the Lakers' home from 1967 to 1999, was built in which Los Angeles-area city?
questions.fact: The Forum was home to six Lakers title teams, from 1972 to 1988.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kia_Forum (Inglewood; Lakers 1967-1999); nba.com/lakers/history/season-capsule ('home to six championship teams'); titles 1972, 80, 82, 85, 87, 88

questions.q: By the late 1990s, the Lakers' Forum carried which sponsored name?
questions.fact: In 1979, Jerry Buss bought the Forum, the Lakers and the NHL's Kings as part of a $67.5 million deal.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kia_Forum (Great Western Forum 1988-2003; Cooke sold it to Buss in 1979 for $67.5M with the Lakers and Kings); nba.com/lakers/history/season-capsule

questions.q: Before Game 7 of the 1969 Finals, owner Jack Kent Cooke planned to release what from the Forum rafters?
questions.fact: Flyers on every seat promised the balloons, plus a USC marching band performance.
questions.src: nba.com/news/history-finals-moments-don-nelsons-shot-helps-secure-win-in-game-7 (balloons in the Forum rafters; 'Flyers were placed in every seat'; USC marching band); en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1969_NBA_Finals

questions.q: Kobe Bryant scored his career high against Toronto in January 2006. How many points was it?
questions.fact: He made 28 of 46 shots and scored 55 of his points in the second half.
questions.src: nba.com/history/top-moments/2006-kobe-bryant-81-points (Jan 22, 2006; 28-46 FG; 55 in second half; 122-104); en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kobe_Bryant's_81-point_game (career high; 62 in three quarters vs Dallas)

questions.q: Magic Johnson's 'junior sky hook' won a 1987 Finals game against which team?
questions.fact: He hit it with two seconds left to give LA a 107-106 win in Game 4.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Celtics-Lakers_rivalry (1987 Finals Game 4: 'junior sky hook' with two seconds left for a 107-106 lead, the final score)

questions.q: Kobe's alley-oop to Shaq capped a Game 7 comeback in the 2000 West finals against which team?
questions.fact: LA trailed 75-60 in the fourth quarter, then went on a 25-4 run.
questions.src: nba.com/news/history-top-moments-kobe-shaq-alley-oop-lakers-comeback (Portland up 75-60 with 10:28 left; Kobe lob to Shaq made it 85-79, i.e. a 25-4 run); en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2000_NBA_Finals (25-4 run)

questions.q: Jerry West's 60-foot shot at the buzzer in Game 3 of the 1970 Finals did what?
questions.fact: There was no three-point line yet, so it counted for two, and the Knicks won in overtime.
questions.src: nba.com/news/history-top-moments-jerry-west-60-footer (Game 3; tied it 102-102; Knicks won in OT); en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1970_NBA_Finals (counted two points, no three-point line); espn.com classic West bio

questions.q: Who was the Lakers' legendary longtime play-by-play broadcaster?
questions.fact: The Lakers honored him with a microphone in the rafters and a statue outside their arena.
questions.src: nba.com/news/la-lakers-retired-numbers ('a microphone for legendary announcer Chick Hearn'); en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Statue_of_Chick_Hearn (unveiled 2010 outside the arena)

questions.q: Which Laker gave himself the nickname 'The Big Aristotle'?
questions.fact: In 1993, as an Orlando Magic player, he released a rap album called Shaq Diesel that went platinum.
questions.src: nba.com/lakers/news/160908shaq-nicknames/ (unveiled 'The Big Aristotle' himself after his 2000 MVP; 1993 album Shaq Diesel went platinum)

questions.q: Which forward on the 2010 Lakers title team later changed his name to Metta World Peace?
questions.fact: The Lakers had signed him in 2009, a year before that championship.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Celtics-Lakers_rivalry ('In 2009, the Lakers signed Ron Artest'); Wikipedia mirror doc.surf Metta Sandiford-Artest (signed July 2009, small forward, legal name change Sept 16, 2011)

questions.q: Which Minneapolis Lakers center was known as 'Mr. Basketball'?
questions.fact: For 1951-52, the NBA widened the lane from 6 to 12 feet, a change dubbed the Mikan Rule.
questions.src: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Mikan ('Mr. Basketball'; lane widened from 6 to 12 feet for 1951-52, the 'Mikan Rule')
